headline: Prismana Pact
title: Prismana Pact | Free rare Aniimo | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Aniimo gives you a free rare Prismana. Open the Events menu and find the Prismana Pact. You choose one of fourteen options, including Grizbo and Magmarex. Guides call Grizbo a safe all rounder and a rage based damage dealer. Other Prismana forms can still be found later, so the pact only picks your head start. Which Prismana would you choose? Comment below!
description: Aniimo Prismana Pact: open the Events menu and choose one of 14 free rare Prismana Aniimo, including Grizbo and Magmarex.
